core_memory.user_preference_espresso: Michael prefers a sleek, modern espresso machine with a stainless-steel finish, designed for a café-like experience without requiring professional barista skills. He values aesthetics and ease of use.
core_memory.user_inquiry_pricing: Michael is a first-time buyer looking for pricing information on espresso machines, specifically interested in any new customer discounts, promotional offers, or bundle deals. He saw a 'New Customer Discount' on the homepage but didn't click it in time.
core_memory.user_shipping_inquiry: Michael in Seattle is concerned about shipping times and origin. He wants to know if products are shipped from a local warehouse, and if not, what the delivery timeframe is—especially since he's hosting a family gathering later this month.
core_memory.user_support_feedback: Michael’s friend praised your customer support for being excellent and detailed, which helped Michael feel confident in asking in-depth questions about coffee machine features, including brewing frequency, cleaning complexity, and footprint size.
core_memory.user_kitchen_space_concern: Michael is concerned about kitchen counter space and wants to know the exact dimensions of the espresso machines to avoid major reorganization. He’s comfortable with minor rearrangements but wants to mentally prepare before making a purchase.
core_memory.user_warranty_inquiry: Michael is concerned about warranty length and customer support quality, especially for higher-end espresso machines. He has had negative experiences with short warranties from other brands and wants assurance of a strong, customer-friendly policy.
core_memory.user_temperature_inquiry: Michael has had issues with drip coffee makers that don’t heat coffee enough, leading him to microwave his coffee. He’s specifically asking whether your espresso machines have adjustable temperature settings or reliably produce hot coffee to enhance his at-home experience.
